wsjHeadlines.description: Bastion, a stablecoin partner for Sony and other corporations, received a conditional approval from OCC to be a trust bank.

wsjHeadlines.description: A shuttle service that slips oil through the Strait of Hormuz now looks like the kingdom’s best fallback.

wsjHeadlines.title: Trump Administration Shift Puts This Corner of Biotech Back in Favor
wsjHeadlines.description: With the Food and Drug Administration’s hard-liners gone, investors are rushing back into rare-disease bets.

wsjHeadlines.description: Expectations for what the Fed will do are driving the recent moves in long-term yields.

wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks ended mixed as inflation and Middle East war trepidation offset optimism about the artificial-intelligence boom.

wsjHeadlines.description: A bond selloff pushed the 2-year Treasury yield to 4.741%, its highest level since July 2024.

wsjHeadlines.title: Nvidia-Backed Cloud Startup Nscale Files for IPO
wsjHeadlines.description: The U.K.-based company didn’t say how many shares it would offer, or at what price, but intends to list shares on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol NSCL.

wsjHeadlines.title: Stocks Decline as Treasury Yields Rise
wsjHeadlines.description: Rising bond yields dampened stock indexes, which were mostly in the red.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. AI-Related Stocks Extend Rally Premarket
wsjHeadlines.description: Stocks linked to the build-out in artificial intelligence continued to rally premarket. Intel rose 2.3%, Sandisk and Micron Technology rose 1.6% and 1.1% respectively.

wsjHeadlines.description: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq composite posted their biggest one-day gains in six weeks.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Up on Hopes Rising Inflation, Oil Prices Are Now Contained
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks recouped some of their recent losses as oil prices stabilized and confidence grew in the Federal Reserve’s ability to contain inflation.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | You Probably Have the Iran War Backward
wsjHeadlines.description: The blockade proves the success of sanctions. If the U.S. keeps its chokehold, Tehran will likely break.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The SEC’s Big and Welcome Proxy Reform
wsjHeadlines.description: The agency wants to stop telling companies how to handle shareholder resolutions.

wsjHeadlines.description: Climate investments pull resources away from fighting poverty.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Bring Back State-Led Corporate Governance
wsjHeadlines.description: Reducing federal oversight will allow states to set rules that focus on business value over politicized initiatives.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | A Flawed Model That Burdens Small Banks
wsjHeadlines.description: The current expected credit losses accounting standard forces banks to predict future economic outcomes and drains resources.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The Treasury’s Bond Strategy Hurts Taxpayers
wsjHeadlines.description: The agency’s justification for doubling its long-term bond purchases is flawed.

wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. natural gas futures settled higher, ending the week with moderate gains as warm summer weather extended well into September.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Futures End Week Little Changed
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil futures ended a frantic week little changed with prices easing back after a midweek rise to four-month highs on disruptions to Saudi Arabia’s East-West pipeline.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gold, Silver Post Weekly Gains Despite Fed Rate Increase
wsjHeadlines.description: Gold futures settled higher on the day and on the week, holding their ground despite the rise in Treasury yields and the Fed’s first interest-rate increase since 2023.
